Billing.xml.notes: Superbills with CPT codes, diagnoses, procedures, modifiers, referring physicians, insurance per transaction

Encounters.xml.notes: SOAP documentation, assessments (ICD/SNOMED), medications (NDC/RxNorm), plans, orders, notes (text + audio), face time

HealthScreening.xml.notes: Goal monitoring, health concerns, screenings (LOINC-coded), immunizations (CVX/NDC), risk factors, prevention programs

Histories.xml.notes: Family/medical/social/surgical history, birth history, sexual history, asthma, habits, hospitalizations, consent history

MedicalInfo.xml.notes: Allergies, problems (ICD-10/SNOMED + cancer staging), vitals, medications (comprehensive), test results (LOINC), behavioral health, CDS alerts, ultrasound, operations, treatment plans

Miscellaneous.xml.notes: Attachments, letters, advance directives, patient education, referrals in, transitions of care

Orders.xml.notes: Orders with category, priority, sender/receiver, status, work-to-do items

Patient.xml.notes: Demographics (incl. SOGI, race/ethnicity), addresses, family members, contacts, insurance policies (detailed), providers, consent records

Schedule.xml.notes: Appointment records with status, provider, times, department, specialty

Specialty.xml.notes: Vision (ophthalmic tests), hearing (audiometric), diabetes (insulin/pump), pediatric developmental, genetic screenings, geriatric assessments, allergy testing

WomenHealth.xml.notes: OB care episodes, initial exams, OB medical history (163 fields!), genetics, deliveries, prenatal visits, EDD calculations, labor progress, pregnancy history, gynecology, menstrual history, family planning
